## About Umbr Corp

Umbr Corp is an independent development org from Brazil. We build fast, polished cross-platform desktop software — tools that feel native on Linux, Windows and macOS without the overhead of traditional desktop stacks.

| Repository | Description | Tech Stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **[`Umbr-Corp/OpenScrcpy`](https://github.com/Umbr-Corp/OpenScrcpy)** | Control Android from the desktop: screen mirroring, phone-as-webcam, and a virtual display with flex resize. | TypeScript, Tauri, Rust |
| **[`Umbr-Corp/Linux-Monocode`](https://github.com/Umbr-Corp/Linux-Monocode)** | Community Linux port of [Monocode](https://github.com/hardbeat920/monocode) — a GUI for your coding agents. *(in development)* | TypeScript |

## 🤝 Contributing & Community

We welcome contributions, bug reports, and ideas across all repositories in the **Umbr Corp** ecosystem:

1. Check open issues or open a new one in the respective repository.
2. Submit PRs following the [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) format.
3. Keep bug reports descriptive and reproducible.

Vulnerabilities are never reported publicly — read [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Umbr-Corp/OpenScrcpy/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for private disclosure.
